name: ruff-action
description: A GitHub Action to run Ruff, an extremely fast Python linter and code formatter.

args.description: Arguments passed to Ruff. Use `ruff --help` to see available options. Defaults to `check`.

src.description: Source to run Ruff. Defaults to the current directory.

version.description: The version of Ruff to use, e.g., `0.6.0` Defaults to the version in pyproject.toml or 'latest'.

version-file.description: Path to a pyproject.toml or requirements.txt file to read the version from.

checksum.description: The checksum of the ruff version to install

github-token.description: Used to increase the rate limit when retrieving versions and downloading ruff.
